_readme: Site content for the Chronicles (projects) and Credentials tabs. Edit with the portfolio editor app, or by hand: run `python3 scripts/build_content.py` afterwards (the GitHub Action also does this on every push). In text fields, **double asterisks** make bold and `backticks` make a code chip. accent is one of: gold, emerald, bright, amber. category is one of: pd, rtl, dft, ic.

projects.title: Taming Dual Asynchronous Clocks: 8-Bit Async FIFO Physical Design
projects.summary: In **Synopsys IC Compiler II**, I drove this layout across a 2,065.43 µm² core while keeping independent write (`wclk`) and read (`rclk`) domains completely isolated from crosstalk and skew.

bullets.label: Floorplan & PDN
bullets.text: 24 M5 ports, 97 DCAPs, M7/M8 + M2 mesh (0 PG DRC).

bullets.label: Dual CTS
bullets.text: `wclk` (80 sinks, 0.51ns) & `rclk` (24 sinks, 0.45ns), each at **0.00 ns skew**.

bullets.label: Signoff
bullets.text: 0 shorts, 0 opens, 0 DRC, +0.16 ns Setup WNS.

links.label: Inspect Layout
links.caption: My 8-Bit Asynchronous FIFO Final Routed Layout (0 DRC, +0.16ns WNS)

projects.title: Conquering a 16-Macro Heavy Block: GPRS Physical Design (`gprs_top`)
projects.summary: Transitioning `gprs_top` from **Design Compiler (`dc_shell`)** into **IC Compiler II (`icc2_shell`)**, I managed 27,811 initial cells (33,286 final) and 16 hard SRAM macros across 10 metal layers.

bullets.label: Core & Power
bullets.text: 391,605.4 µm² core (66.25% final util); fixed 179 missing PG vias.

bullets.label: CTS & Congestion
bullets.text: 2,856 `mclk` sinks at 0.14 ns skew; 0.12% placement congestion.

bullets.label: Signoff
bullets.text: Cleared 34 route shorts via `route_eco`; 0.00 ns Setup WNS/TNS.

links.label: View Layout
links.caption: My gprs_top 10-Layer Detailed Route & SRAM Macro Signoff in Synopsys ICC2

projects.title: Zero Internet, Pure RTL: My Multi-Master Bus Arbiter at ChipThink Finals
projects.summary: At the **ChipThink VLSI Hackathon** (Maven Silicon & IEEE), my teammates and I designed and verified a deterministic Verilog Bus Arbiter for CPU, DMA, and Peripheral masters completely offline.

bullets.label: Anti-Starvation
bullets.text: 8-clock-cycle fairness counter forces priority rotation if DMA/Peripherals wait continuously.

bullets.label: Verified
bullets.text: Live hardware debug state tracking across all contention cases.

projects.title: Peeling Back the Compiler: 4-Abstraction Verilog & CMOS Switch Verification
projects.summary: Built a combinational half adder across Dataflow (`assign`), Behavioral (`always @(*)`), Gate-Level, and Switch-Level CMOS (`pmos`/`nmos` wired to `VDD`/`VSS`), verified simultaneously via a SystemVerilog testbench (`tb_top`) in **Synopsys VCS**.

projects.title: EV Station Controller at ChipCraft 2.0
projects.summary: Developed and synthesized a robust EV charging station controller during the ChipCraft 2.0 hackathon. The design integrates a PMU arbiter, smart FIFO, port timer unit, and toggle synchronization to handle complex state management and multi-clock domain data transfer.

bullets.text: Designed modular RTL using Verilog, including pmu_arbiter_fsm, ibmu_smart_fifo, and
Implemented cdc_toggle_sync for reliable Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) data integrity
Verified functionality using SystemVerilog testbenches (tb_ev_station.sv) and VCS simulations.
Performed RTL synthesis and generated area/timing/power reports using Synopsys Design Compiler.

projects.title: Stripping Away Proprietary GUIs: OpenLane & SKY130 RTL-to-GDSII
projects.summary: Executed a 70+ step open-source physical realization pipeline for a **Serial-Parallel Multiplier (SPM)** using Yosys, Verilator, OpenROAD, Magic, and KLayout in the **SkyWater 130nm (`sky130_fd_sc_hd`)** PDK.

projects.title: Achieving 0.00% Route Overflow & 0.011 ns Skew in Cadence Innovus
projects.summary: Placed standard cells at 53.189% density (Pre-CTS WNS: +0.846 ns), balanced the clock tree to **0.011 ns skew** (boosting Post-CTS WNS to +1.377 ns), and completed routing with **0.00% overflow**.

projects.title: Making Silicon Testable: Memory Block DFT in Cadence Genus & Modus
projects.summary: Implemented scan-chain insertion, stitched scan flip-flops, validated shift/capture modes, and resolved DFT rule violations using the **Cadence Genus–Modus** flow.

projects.title: My First Full Flow Milestone: PLL Design from RTL to Routing
projects.summary: Drove a Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) from RTL through Synthesis, Placement, CTS, Routing, and pre-layout functional simulation using **Synopsys Design Vision & IC Compiler** at the Centre for Chip Design Lab.

projects.title: Where It Started: My Breadboard 4-Bit Fast Multiplier & Barrel Shifter
projects.summary: Built a discrete IC 4-bit binary multiplier (`15 × 15 = 225 / 11100001₂`) on a breadboard using AND gate arrays and 4-bit full adders, paired with RTL synthesis analysis of an 8-bit combinatorial Barrel Shifter.
